changes: Cost Library keeps units and currency amounts readable when long item descriptions require scrolling.
Scanned PDF plans using JPEG2000 images render with bundled offline decoder resources instead of opening as blank pages.
Opening a project from Estimate waits for a visible canvas before fitting the plan, preventing invalid zoom from blocking project saves and recovery.
Take off counts, lengths, areas, perimeters and walls from PDF floor plans, with embedded plans in saved projects.
Protected project saves retain one last-good adjacent backup after a successful replacement save.
Project prices retain their rate units when display units change. Older prices need their rate units reviewed before release use.
Format-3 portable projects preserve rate units and require original-preserving upgraded copies.
Periodic recovery copies, bounded workbook import and PDF raster retention improve offline reliability.
compatibility: Reads project formats 1, 2 and 3; writes format 3 (minimum reader 3). First saves of older projects require a separate upgraded copy. Retain the prior installer and pre-upgrade original for rollback. Recovery runs approximately every 60 seconds while dirty and retains up to 20 candidates within 4 GiB; save explicitly to protect the latest work.
